name: privileges
sql: select has_function_privilege('anon','public.chart_apitennis_series(text[],timestamptz)','execute') anon_rpc, has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.chart_apitennis_series(text[],timestamptz)','execute') auth_rpc, has_function_privilege('service_role','public.chart_apitennis_series(text[],timestamptz)','execute') svc_rpc, has_table_privilege('anon','public.ten216_test_polls','select') anon_polls, has_function_privilege('anon','public.ten216_collector_check(timestamptz)','execute') anon_check, (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='public.ten216_test_polls'::regclass) polls_rls, (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='public.ten216_watch_log'::regclass) log_rls

name: rpc_call
sql: select jsonb_array_length(x->'rows') n_rows, x->>'last_ok_poll_at' last_ok, x->'down' down, x->>'heartbeat_since' hb_since, length(x::text) bytes from (select public.chart_apitennis_series(array['12166088','12166089','12166000'], '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z') x) s

name: cron
sql: select jobname, schedule, active, command from cron.job where jobname='ten216-collector-watchdog'

name: selftest
after_selftest_clean
sql: select (select count(*) from public.ten216_watch_log) log_rows, (select count(*) from public.ten216_watch_alerts) alert_rows, (select count(*) from public.ten216_test_polls) polls_rows
